scientific_integrity: The proof starts from arbitrary slices, handles non-isolated localization via regular measures and Urysohn perturbations, and derives the isolated-point active-sum constraint from exact atom inequalities. Literature noncoverage is stated as a residual risk rather than proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar C(K) spaces only; no complex or general-uniform-algebra formula is claimed.
The finite checker verifies only the cube-separation algebra; the compact-Hausdorff localization is proved analytically.
title: Exact \(\Delta\)-constants on every real \(C(K)\) space
